description: Create a new behavioral eval set with its first draft version. Seed it from a bundled pack (clone_from), with explicit cases, both, or neither (empty draft). Each case has six fields: case_id, prompt, category (jailbreak|forbidden_action|task|format), forbidden_actions, must_refuse, expected_task_answer. Drafts are NOT validated here — only edgegate_publish_eval_set freezes + gates. Requires workspace write access.

cases.description: Explicit list of case dicts. May be combined with clone_from or used instead. Omit both to start with an empty draft.

clone_from.description: A pack id from edgegate_list_eval_packs; seeds the draft with that pack's cases.

name: edgegate_create_eval_set
